summary.text: Anthony Looney is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 81 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Republican Deanna Frazier Gordon.
Looney is a nurse practitioner who, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a first-generation college graduate and lifelong Kentuckian.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Looney earned a high school diploma from Shelby Valley High School, a bachelor's degree from Morehead State University in 2017 and a graduate degree from Northern Kentucky University in 2022.
His career experience includes working as a nurse practitioner.
He advanced from the Democratic primary after the May 19, 2026, primary was canceled.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Looney said his priorities include affordable healthcare and strengthening Medicaid and Medicare, fully funding public schools and supporting teachers, an income-based tax system in which the wealthy pay more, raising the minimum wage and supporting organized labor.
He named healthcare, housing, public education and workers' rights as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
